mechanisms.title: Item Category Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: The item category is the item's operating license.
mechanisms.question: What is this sales item allowed to do?

inputs.name: item usage
inputs.origin: process context; sometimes set internally by SAP

mechanisms.determination: Item category determination is a Customizing lookup. SAP evaluates sales document type + material item category group + item usage + higher-level item category. The matching assignment proposes a default item category and can also define allowed alternative item categories that the user may select. Usage is often blank for normal material items; SAP can set TEXT internally for text items entered without a material in inquiries or quotations, and FREE for free-goods items.
configuration_surfaces: Define Item Categories
Assign Item Categories: sales document type + item category group + usage + higher-level item category
Maintain the default item category and any allowed manual alternatives
Standard examples to recognize: TAN standard, TATX text, TANN free of charge, TAS third-party; customer configuration can use different categories

failure_modes.prove: Trace sales document type + item category group + usage + higher-level item category, then check the matching default category before changing configuration.

failure_modes.symptom: Expected alternative item category cannot be selected
failure_modes.prove: Check whether that alternative is explicitly allowed for the same determination combination; a category can exist without being selectable here.

failure_modes.symptom: Text or free-goods item gets unexpected behavior
failure_modes.prove: Prove the usage value first. TEXT and FREE can steer item-category determination before downstream pricing, schedule-line or billing checks.

failure_modes.symptom: No schedule line or wrong billing behavior
failure_modes.prove: Prove the item category first; those symptoms may be downstream effects rather than separate defects.

failure_modes.symptom: Special item behaves like a normal item
failure_modes.prove: Trace item category group, usage and higher-level item category. For BOMs, first prove whether ERLA or LUMF is intended.

tests.setup: Keep the sales document type constant and change only the material item-category group.
tests.assert: The proposed item category follows the maintained determination combination.

tests.setup: Maintain one default item category and one allowed alternative for the same determination key.
tests.assert: SAP proposes the default category and the configured alternative is available for manual selection.

tests.setup: Create a subitem under a known higher-level item category.
tests.assert: The higher-level item category participates in item-category determination.

tests.setup: Compare a normal material item with a supported text-item or free-goods scenario.
tests.assert: The usage context participates in determination and leads to the configured item-category behavior.

tests.setup: Create a normal item, a text item, a free-of-charge subitem and a Sales BOM in controlled standard-like configuration.
tests.assert: Each item receives the expected category and different pricing, schedule-line, delivery or subitem behavior.

item_examples.note: Classic standard example. A text item can be used without a material number and is controlled separately from a normal material item.
Classic standard example for a free-of-charge item; free-goods determination can create it as a subitem.
Classic third-party example: the item category participates in switching fulfillment from own delivery to procurement.
Common standard Sales BOM categories associated with ERLA and LUMF processing; always read them together with item category group and higher-level item context.
Standard delivery item example for make-to-order production from a standard order.

mechanisms.title: Partner Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: A document is not just what was sold; it is who is allowed to play each role.
mechanisms.question: Who is sold-to, ship-to, bill-to, payer, contact, or another process partner, and why?
mechanisms.determination: A partner determination procedure defines the partner functions, whether they are mandatory or changeable, and how partners are sourced.
outputs: partner functions at header and/or item level
configuration_surfaces: Set Up Partner Determination
Assign procedures to document types and item categories

failure_modes.prove: Check procedure assignment, mandatory functions, source control, and master partner relationships.
Compare the actual partner functions before debugging the downstream mechanism.

tests.setup: Use a sold-to with a distinct ship-to and payer relationship.
tests.assert: Document partner functions are populated according to the assigned procedure and source rules.

mechanisms.title: Pricing
mechanisms.memory_hook: First prove the procedure. Only then hunt the condition record.
mechanisms.question: Which pricing procedure runs, and how does it find each price element?
mechanisms.determination: Sales area + customer pricing procedure + document pricing procedure determine the pricing procedure. The procedure then processes condition types and their access sequences to find condition records.
configuration_surfaces: Pricing procedure determination
Pricing procedures
Condition types
Access sequences
Condition tables

failure_modes.symptom: Condition record exists but price is missing
failure_modes.prove: Prove pricing procedure → condition type → access sequence → access key → validity before editing the record.
Check copy-control pricing type and whether billing reprices or copies conditions.

tests.setup: Create two customers with different customer pricing procedure values and identical material/quantity.
tests.assert: The determined pricing procedure follows the configured key.

tests.setup: Maintain a specific customer-material condition and a generic fallback.
tests.assert: The access sequence finds the more specific valid record first when configured that way.

mechanisms.title: Copy Control
mechanisms.memory_hook: Copy control is the contract between a predecessor and its follow-on document.
mechanisms.question: What may flow from the source document into the target, what must be checked first, and when is the source considered referenced or complete?

inputs.name: source schedule line category
inputs.origin: preceding schedule line when schedule-line copying is relevant

inputs.name: copying requirements, data-transfer routines and switches
completion rule
inputs.origin: item category of the preceding sales item

mechanisms.determination: A valid source-to-target relationship is the starting point. Copy control is maintained at header, item and schedule-line level. At each level SAP can check copying requirements, run data-transfer routines and apply transaction-specific switches. At item and schedule-line level, the target category can be proposed from the relevant category assignment when no valid target is entered. For reference progress, the item-level Document flow update setting updates referred quantities or values in the predecessor, while the completion rule in the preceding item's item category decides when that item becomes complete.
outputs: referred quantity/value progress in the predecessor
controls: whether a source/target document relationship is allowed
target item and schedule-line category proposal
configuration_surfaces: Sales document → sales document copy control with header, item and schedule-line levels
Copying requirements at the relevant level
Data-transfer routines for header, partner, business, item or schedule-line data as required
Transaction-specific switches such as copying source item numbers
Item-level Document flow update when reference quantities or values must update the predecessor
Completion rule in the source item category; this decides when the preceding item is treated as completed
Target item/schedule-line category proposal must be valid in the corresponding category assignment
Classic/on-premise routine maintenance in VOFM; prefer suitable standard routines before creating custom logic

failure_modes.symptom: Create with Reference is not possible for the expected document chain
failure_modes.prove: Start with the source/target document-type relationship. Then check the relevant header, item and schedule-line entries before looking at transfer logic.

failure_modes.symptom: The target exists, but copying is rejected or stops with a warning/error
failure_modes.prove: Check copying requirements first. They run before data-transfer routines and can reject the reference because of status, validity, sold-to or other business conditions.

failure_modes.symptom: Wrong fields, partners, business data or pricing arrive in the target
failure_modes.prove: Trace the data-transfer routine, pricing type and switches at the level that owns the field. Do not treat every difference as a pricing or master-data defect.

failure_modes.symptom: A partial reference closes the predecessor too early, or keeps it open too long
failure_modes.prove: Separate document-flow update from completion logic. The item-level update records reference progress; the completion rule in the preceding item category decides when the item becomes complete.

failure_modes.symptom: Reference quantities or values do not update in the predecessor as expected
failure_modes.prove: Check the item-level Document flow update setting before changing the completion rule.

failure_modes.symptom: Unexpected target item or schedule-line category
failure_modes.prove: Check the maintained target category and the corresponding category assignment. A target proposal must be allowed by the relevant assignment.

tests.setup: Create a quotation for quantity 10, then create an order with reference for quantity 4 under a completion rule that requires full reference.
tests.assert: The quotation item remains partially referred and can still be referenced for the remaining quantity.

tests.setup: Reference the remaining quantity 6 from the same quotation.
tests.assert: The quotation item becomes completed when the full quantity has been referenced.

tests.setup: Create an inquiry and reference only part of its quantity in a quotation under a completion rule that completes on first reference.
tests.assert: The inquiry item is completed after the first valid reference even though the referenced quantity is partial.

tests.setup: Use a source document that intentionally fails a configured copying requirement, for example because the business condition for reference creation is not met.
tests.assert: The system blocks or warns before the transfer routines create the target content.

tests.setup: Compare a valid target item/schedule-line proposal with an invalid or unmaintained alternative.
tests.assert: Only target categories allowed by the relevant category assignment can be used.

copy_levels.match: source sales document type → target sales document type
copy_levels.controls: Header copying requirement, header/business/partner data transfer, and switches such as copying source item numbers.

copy_levels.match: source item category → target item category
copy_levels.controls: Item requirement, item/business data transfer, quantity/value handling, pricing type, target category proposal, and Document flow update.

copy_levels.match: source schedule line category → target schedule line category
copy_levels.controls: Schedule-line requirement, schedule-line data transfer, and target category proposal when schedule-line copying is relevant.

control_stack.name: 1. Source → target relationship
control_stack.purpose: Defines whether this document chain is supported at all.

control_stack.name: 2. Copying requirement
control_stack.purpose: Guards the copy. If the requirement fails, transfer should not continue.

control_stack.name: 3. Data-transfer routine
control_stack.purpose: Moves or derives the fields that belong in the target.

control_stack.name: 4. Switches
control_stack.purpose: Apply transaction-specific choices such as item-number transfer or other copy options.

control_stack.name: 5. Target category mapping
control_stack.purpose: Controls which target item and schedule-line categories are used or proposed.

control_stack.name: 6. Reference-status logic
control_stack.purpose: Document flow update records reference progress; the source item category's completion rule decides when the predecessor is complete.

reference_status_model.document_flow_update: At item level, Document flow update keeps referred quantities or values and the reference status of the preceding item in step with the follow-on document.
reference_status_model.completion_rule_owner: The completion rule is maintained in the item category of the preceding sales item, not in the copy-control table.

examples.behavior: Complete on the first valid reference.
examples.example: An inquiry item can become Completed as soon as a quotation refers to it, even when only part of the quantity is referenced.

examples.behavior: Complete only after the full quantity is referenced.
examples.example: A quotation item stays Partially referred after a partial order and remains available for further reference until the total quantity is used.

reference_status_model.rejection_note: A reason for rejection also gives the item a Completed status.

mechanisms.lead_answer: I treat copy control as a source-to-target contract. First I prove the valid source/target relationship. Then I check the copying requirement, data-transfer routine, switches and target item/schedule-line mapping. For status questions I separate two controls: Document flow update records the reference progress, while the completion rule in the source item category decides when the predecessor is complete. That is why a quotation can remain partially referred after a partial order, while an inquiry can be completed after the first reference.

mechanisms.title: Incompletion Procedure and Log
mechanisms.memory_hook: Completeness is a process control, not a cosmetic warning.
mechanisms.question: Which missing fields make this document incomplete, and what may be blocked because of them?

inputs.name: sales document type / item category / schedule-line context
fields and status groups defined for the procedure
actual document data and missing values

mechanisms.determination: The incompletion procedure defines which fields are checked for the relevant sales-document context and how missing data affects status. The incompletion log records missing data; depending on configuration and the missing field, further processing such as copying, delivery or billing can be blocked even when the document itself can be saved.
configuration_surfaces: Define incompletion procedures
Assign incompletion procedures to sales document types and item categories
Define fields and status groups relevant for further processing

failure_modes.symptom: Order saves but delivery or billing is blocked
failure_modes.prove: Open the incompletion log and identify the missing field → status group → affected follow-on function before changing copy, delivery or billing configuration.

failure_modes.symptom: Business expects a mandatory field but SAP does not flag it
failure_modes.prove: Check the procedure assignment and whether the field is included in the relevant incompletion procedure for the correct header/item/schedule-line context.

failure_modes.symptom: A harmless missing field blocks too much processing
failure_modes.prove: Trace the field's status-group effect before removing the field from completeness control entirely.

tests.setup: Create a sales document with one configured required field missing and inspect the incompletion log and document status.
tests.assert: The missing field appears in the log and the configured follow-on processing effect is visible.

tests.setup: Compare two missing fields assigned to different status effects in a controlled test design.
tests.assert: Only the follow-on functions configured for each incompleteness case are blocked.
